title: SOLID in Non-OOP Practice
objectives: Map SRP, OCP and DIP onto Rust traits and Vue composables
Use composition instead of inheritance hierarchies
Recognize when SOLID framing becomes ceremony

examples.name: notifier.rs

exercise.prompt: A Vue composable does fetch + caching + rendering-prep in one function. Which SOLID-inspired split fixes it? Render the plan.
hints: SRP: separate the change reasons — I/O, state lifetime, presentation.
The split should make each piece independently testable.

questions.prompt: Dependency Inversion in Rust is most naturally expressed via…
questions.explanation: Traits plus generic parameters invert the dependency: policy depends on the abstraction.

questions.prompt: When does applying SOLID become harmful?
options: when abstraction is added with no second use case or change reason
questions.explanation: Speculative abstraction is ceremony; principles serve change, not form.
